Your poster and reel are ready.

**Poster (vertical 9:16, 640px):**

**Reel (8 seconds, 9:16, 480p, no sound):**
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbi5im704nfgq015piez39u/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023126Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

**How they match:** I animated the reel from the poster itself, so it has the same art and text. The camera stays still and only the lights, steam and lanterns move. I told the model to keep the text unchanged for the whole clip.

**Please check the text first:** I couldn't open the files to look at them myself. AI image models sometimes misspell words, and a video model can make small letters flicker. Before you share them, check that "Night Market", "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard" and "Free entry" are spelled correctly on the poster and stay sharp all the way through the reel.

If anything is wrong, I can make the text exact instead. I'd lay the words over the animated background in code, so they can't change. Tell me which version you want.

The links stop working after 24 hours, so download the files soon. This used 202 credits: 10 for the poster and 192 for the reel.
